visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a rapid montage of various packaged food items being held in hands against the backdrop of a bright convenience store. The lighting is even and typical of retail environments. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a pink plastic package from Lawson. Hands tear open the wrapper to reveal a dark, sugar-dusted pastry puff. The pastry is held and then cut in half to show a thick, light pink cream filling inside. The background transitions to a neutral wooden table surface. (3) The scene shifts to a refrigerated shelf stocked with various sandwiches. A hand selects a package of strawberry and cream sandwiches from 7-Eleven. The sandwich is unboxed and shown in a close-up, revealing white bread slices filled with whipped cream and large, halved red strawberries. (4) Another transition shows a hand holding a yellow and orange package from FamilyMart. The wrapper is peeled away to reveal a soft, light-colored chiffon cake. The cake is broken apart to reveal layers of white cream and a darker coffee-colored cream center. (5) The final sequence shows a wide shot of convenience store shelves stocked with various products, followed by a graphic screen with social media icons and text handles against a pink and white background.

(2) Faint, high-frequency rustling sounds are occasionally audible, suggesting the manipulation of thin plastic packaging. However, these incidental sounds are low in intensity and largely buried beneath the dominant, loud musical track. The music maintains its energetic tone without pause. (3) The musical structure reaches a chorus section with increased vocal energy and instrumental layering. The production remains studio-clean with a narrow dynamic range. The track continues linearly through the end of the video segment without cuts or changes in genre.
